method: Blind adjudication by Claude Opus 5.5 subagents: arms anonymised as A-D, findings clustered by root cause and verified read-only against the reviewed worktree.

keeper-idle-retire.summary: Retirement treats 2h of Events silence as proof the worker exited; a live worker whose provider socket dropped (Claude reconnects only on next call) or a long partition loses its keeper/executor state
Cached target readiness survives self-retirement, so dispatch skips Describe and the next prompt goes to the dead binding and is cancelled
Expiry check and shutdown notification are not atomic with request admission; an Invoke/Describe can be admitted between the decision and ledger.lose()
Describe does not refresh attendance, so a wake near expiry can get Ready and lose the keeper during worker cold start
Finished managed calls are explicitly retired, but conversation=continue (and Reload) relaunch the worker on the saved binding without wake recovery
Retirement drops the keeper's (dev,inode) workspace guard; recovery relaunches by pathname so a replaced worktree at the same path is accepted
A keeper launched by Prepare/Recover whose binding the Controller never committed can retire, after which retries return EnvironmentLost forever
Retirement is not gated on recovery being possible; e.g. a changed configured executor digest makes the saved binding unrecoverable
cgroup-suffix eligibility is decoupled from the Machine's launch mode / loss-proof logic

pr8818.summary: Whole-info entitlement writers (UpdateEntitlementInfo, NewEntitlementTerm, UpdateEntitlementAwsLicenseArn) copy awsBuyerContact from a replica/stale read and can erase a just-saved answer
Contact-answer UPDATE is unconditional (org+ID only): concurrent unchecked workers both save/derive, and stale agreement/buyer snapshots can be written onto a repaired/reassigned row
Company enrichment calls full-row UpdateBuyer from a pre-AWS-call (possibly batch-prefetched) buyer snapshot, overwriting concurrent seller edits
Serial 30s-per-agreement optional AWS call inside the agreement sync loop can exhaust the activity deadline and starve required reconciliation
Answer is committed before Contact/link/company derivation; any partial failure is never retried
Local replace of marketplaceagreement SDK breaks downstream importers / masks upgrades
run-ai-tests discovers the live aws-buyer-profiles.plan.md by default though its fixtures are unavailable
affected.js can pass only the opt-in-ignored local spec to Playwright, yielding 'no tests found'
Entitlement guard rejects empty PartnerID, so single-account (legacy empty partner_id) sellers never get buyer contacts
CPPO data-feed fallback buyer may differ from the acceptor, attaching acceptor contact to wrong buyer
SQS SUBSCRIBE_SUCCESS path leaves meta.IntegrationPartnerID empty, so named-integration entitlements skip enrichment
Terminal MDFS-created agreements without AwsAgreementV2 bypass the cancelled check
DB error during contact lookup logs the buyer's email
Offer sidebar may show a contact from a non-newest entitlement (>1000 entitlements) / no buyerID recheck
Fixture cleanup deletes fixture organization, cascading unchecked tables
Live external test prints real contact on assertion mismatch
Contact-id queryFn returns undefined on miss (TanStack error) and ilike 1000-row search may miss exact match
Entitlement UPDATE notifications now include awsBuyerContact PII in webhook/SNS payloads

pr8895.summary: Open auto-apply CRM-push workflow swallows the approval's push (same workflow ID, non-override start returns open run without new allowFields); suggestion then recorded PUSHED
Later approval push only sends approveFields and overwrites single crmPush, hiding an earlier FAILED auto-applied push
Approval writes a full dealDetails/nextSteps snapshot without a conditional DB write; concurrent or token-less approvals can lose unrelated Seller edits
Decision committed before Seller write; a crash between them leaves APPROVED suggestion with unapplied values
Raw Seller CRM error text (Opportunity ID, Salesforce response body) stored on the partner copy's suggestion and returned to the partner org
Approving amount+currency pushes only Amount (default mappings lack currency), writing amount in wrong denomination
A replacement suggestion during push backoff drops the original's failure outcome and makes Retry impossible
Engagement-sync start failure after Seller write is swallowed as a successful apply
New default close-date filler sends raw RFC3339 timestamp to Salesforce Date field (dateFormat expression removed)
Skipped CRM write (inactive/Expired Seller copy, nil HubSpot client) returns nil and is recorded PUSHED
Orgs with saved legacy expression-only close-date mapping get NOT_MAPPED for close-date approvals
Account-only Salesforce links classified NOT_LINKED by startCrmStep
HubSpot fetcher passes {configs,lastUpdateTime} envelope to crmsMissing, suppressing all missing-mapping markers
Console PENDING branch hides CrmPushNotice/Retry for failed auto-applied fields
Review selection state survives a 409 refresh / new suggestion, keeping stale fields checked
Worker/DB interruption leaves push with no recorded outcome (maximumAttempts 1, record outside try)
Impossible RFC3339 close date (2026-02-31T..) accepted at submission but fails on apply
Initial partner next steps never populate Seller partnerNextSteps (rebuild only on change/removal)
Salesforce review dialog Promise.all: one missing CRM config blanks all mapping targets
Closed (terminal) Seller copy: UI still offers approve/decline that API rejects; pending suggestion stranded
Currency accepted as arbitrary non-empty string
Salesforce LWC formats money with 0 fraction digits, hiding sub-unit changes
Console says only approved fields are written though Sync-on fields are also pushed
Console marks every field 'Not in CRM' while mapping is loading or failed
Review email says 'Nothing changes until you approve' after auto-apply already ran
PR description lists stage/next steps as suggestible; asks to correct the description
Withdrawn/replaced/declined suggestion can still auto-apply because autoApply never rechecks the suggestion
autoAppliedFields published before Seller write; if Seller decides meanwhile and autoApply fails, correction write matches 0 rows and decided suggestion claims an unapplied field
